description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git merge functionality, specifically testing various scenarios such as renames, directory renames, conflicts, and dirty changes. It includes setup functions, expected result assertions, and test execution commands for verifying merge behavior in different edge cases.

methods.name: test_setup_1a
methods.description: Sets up a repository with a specific sequence of commits representing no renames with subset changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success '1a-L: Modify(A)/Modify(B), change on B subset of A'
methods.description: Executes a merge scenario where subset modifications are merged on the left side.

methods.name: test_expect_success '1a-R: Modify(A)/Modify(B), change on B subset of A'
methods.description: Executes a merge scenario where subset modifications are merged on the right side.

methods.name: test_setup_2a
methods.description: Sets up a repository involving renames on one side.

methods.name: test_expect_success '2a-L: Modify/rename, merge into modify side'
methods.description: Tests merging where a rename on one side is merged into a modification.

methods.name: test_expect_success '2a-R: Modify/rename, merge into rename side'
methods.description: Tests merging where a rename on one side merges into a different renamed file.

methods.name: test_setup_2b
methods.description: Sets up a repository with a rename and modifications occurring separately.

methods.name: test_expect_success '2b-L...'
methods.description: Tests merge scenarios involving renames and modifications, verifying correct content and path resolution.

methods.name: test_expect_success '2b-R...'
methods.description: Mirror of the previous test for the other side of merge.

methods.name: test_setup_2c
methods.description: Sets up a complex scenario with modifications, renames, and add conflicts.

methods.name: test_expect_success '2c: Modify b & add c VS rename b->c'
methods.description: Tests handling of rename/add conflicts during merge.

methods.name: test_setup_3a
methods.description: Prepares directory rename scenarios where files move into directories.

methods.name: test_expect_success '3a-L: bq_1->foo/bq_2 on A, foo/->bar/ on B'
methods.description: Validates merge with directory renames, ensuring correct path and content resolution.

methods.name: test_expect_success '3a-R...'
methods.description: Reverse scenario for directory rename merge.

methods.name: test_setup_3b
methods.description: Sets up directory renames with concurrent changes on directories.

methods.name: test_expect_success '3b-L...'
methods.description: Tests directory rename conflicts in merge scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success '3b-R...'
methods.description: Reverse directory rename merging tests.

methods.name: test_setup_4a
methods.description: Prepares a scenario with local modifications, renames, and subset changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success '4a: Change on A, change on B subset of A, dirty mods present'
methods.description: Tests merge behavior with local modifications conflicting with incoming changes.

methods.name: test_setup_4b
methods.description: Sets up change, rename, and modification conflicts with local modifications.

methods.name: test_expect_success '4b: Rename+Mod(A)/Mod(B), change on B subset of A, dirty mods present'
methods.description: Verifies correct handling of rename and modification conflicts with local dirty state.
